mapper.select: SELECT cs.id, cs.realm_id, cs.user_session_id, cs.client_id, cs.deleted, cs.created_time, cs.updated_time, us.sid AS sid, us.user_id AS user_id, c.client_key AS client_key FROM iam_client_session cs JOIN iam_user_session us ON us.id = cs.user_session_id LEFT JOIN iam_client c ON c.id = cs.client_id WHERE us.sid = #{sid} AND us.realm_id = #{realmId} AND cs.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY cs.id

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_client_session (realm_id, user_session_id, client_id, deleted) VALUES (#{realmId}, #{userSessionId}, #{clientId}, FALSE)
